facts.text: BSc Computer Engineering, Fictional State University (FSU), Nigeria, 2020 to 2025.
CGPA 4.30 out of 5.00, Second Class Upper.
Dean's list for 2 sessions.
Embedded Systems Intern, BrightGrid Solar, 5 months in 2024. Wrote data logging firmware for a solar sensor board.
Tested firmware on 12 sensor boards.
SunTrack: low cost solar panel monitoring system built with ESP32 microcontroller and wireless sensors. Tested on 3 rooftop panels. Final year project.
SunTrack dashboard: Python web dashboard that shows panel output over time.
Organized the FSU campus hackathon with 120 participants.
Member, FSU Tech Club, 2021 to 2025.
Played for FSU university football team for 4 years.
Python for Data Science online course certificate, 2023.
Embedded Systems Fundamentals certificate, 2022.
Skills: Python, C, SQL, Git, ESP32, Arduino.
Languages: English, Yoruba.
Digital Electronics: Grade A
Embedded Systems: Grade A
Data Structures and Algorithms: Grade A
Power Systems: Grade A
Machine Learning: Grade B
Control Systems: Grade B
Engineering Mathematics: Grade B
Communication Systems: Grade C
Final Year Project (SunTrack solar monitoring): Grade A
Captained the FSU football team for 2 seasons.
Volunteered as a coding teacher at Community Secondary School. Taught Python to 40 students over 200 hours across 2 years.
Eight students entered a state science fair.
Holds a first aid certificate from 2022.
Assistant coordinator of the FSU Tech Club for the 2023 to 2024 session.
Departmental prize for best final year project in 2025.
Self-taught basic French.
Family income was too low to pay full fees in second year, so tutored students on weekends to cover costs.
Goal: design low cost energy monitoring systems that help small businesses in Nigeria use solar power reliably.
Wants a Master's in AI for energy systems because leading research groups on energy forecasting and smart grids are abroad.
